hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */e2e/*.ts) HITS=$(grep -nE 'waitForTimeout\([0-9]|\.nth\(|\.catch\(\(\) =>|locator\("(input|textarea)\[name=|page\.fill\("(input|textarea)\[' "$f" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$HITS" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"E2E lint warning in $f:\n$HITS\nConsider: use constants from helpers/constants.ts for timeouts, getByLabel() instead of CSS name selectors, getByRole('img') instead of .nth(), and avoid silent .catch() swallows.\"}}"; fi ;; esac; }

hooks.prompt:
You are a Swiss International Typographic Style reviewer for ws-gong.com. A file was just edited; the edit (tool input, including the file path and the change) is: $ARGUMENTS

Ignore non-layout files (anything outside app/ or not .tsx/.css). Review ONLY the changed content against SPEC.md §6.1:

1. GRID: one 12-column grid governs every page; nothing floats free of it.
2. COLUMN LINES: every element starts on a column line and ends inside the grid; nothing extends into the margin. Wider content spans more columns rather than breaking the grid.
3. FLUSH LEFT, RAGGED RIGHT: no right-aligned, centered, or justified text or blocks; no edge-pushing (ml-auto, mx-auto, justify-end, text-right, text-center).
4. ASYMMETRY: label left (cols 1-4), content right (5-12); masthead 1-7; nav 11-12 starting on the column-11 line.
5. HIERARCHY by scale and position, not decoration: no shadows, gradients, rounded corners, or ornament. Weights: 700 display (masthead, page titles), 500 titles/labels/emphasis, 400 body.
6. RULES: a full rule tops each section; lists draw hairlines between rows only, never above the first row or below the last.
7. WHITESPACE from tokens and section rhythm, never ad hoc.

If the edit complies, say nothing. Flag only clear violations, each with the rule number and a one-line fix.
